data.name: Demonshield
data.description: After a creature deals damage to you, if you are in Crisis, you may have that creature suffer shaken.

data.name: Shield of Spring
data.description: Whenever you recover Hit Points, you recover 5 additional Hit Points.

data.name: Seraph Shield
data.description: As long as you are in Crisis, you are immune to all status effects.

data.name: Adamantower
data.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Defense and Magic Defense (already included).

data.name: Bag Shield
data.description: When a Skill lets you regain Inventory Points, you regain 1 additional Inventory Point.

data.name: Drumshield
data.description: If you have the Resonance Skill, consider your Skill Level in it increased by 2 (up to a maximum of SL 5).

data.name: Argus
data.description: When you use the King’s Castle and Bishop’s Edict Skills, you may exclude one creature you can see from their effects.

data.name: Shield of Blades
data.description: When you attack with a weapon belonging to the heavy, spear, or sword Category, if the attack has the multi property, that attack deals 5 extra damage.

data.name: Parry Shield
data.description: If you have the Counterattack Skill, the Skill also triggers when the result of an enemy’s Accuracy Check is an odd number.

data.name: Plate Manica
data.description: As long as you have no martial armor and no other shield equipped, you may apply the effects of the Dodge Skill.

data.name: Lid Shield
data.description: When you deal damage with a delicacy, you deal 5 extra damage.

data.name: Lily Vambrace
data.description: If you have the Battle Gardening Skill, you can use it when you plant a magiseed with the Graft Skill.

data.name: Icebreaker
data.description: All physical and fire damage you deal ignores Resistances.

data.name: Ballistic Shield
data.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Accuracy Check with ranged weapons.

data.name: Windshield
data.description: While driving your personal vehicle, you gain Resistance to air and ice damage.

data.name: Hekat Shield
data.description: You gain Resistance to damage dealt by spells. When a spell deals damage to you, you recover 5 Mind Points.
